questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the macroeconomic picture presented in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Real GDP growth for FY26 is placed at 7.4 per cent in the First Advance Estimates.
2. India is described as the fastest-growing major economy for the fourth consecutive year.
3. Real GDP growth for FY27 is projected at 7.5 to 8.0 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Survey places FY26 growth at 7.4 per cent (First Advance Estimates) and calls India the fastest-growing major economy for a fourth straight year. For FY27 it projects only 6.8 to 7.2 per cent, with potential growth at about 7 per cent, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, State of the Economy; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about inflation in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Average headline CPI inflation during April-December 2025 was 1.7 per cent, the lowest since the CPI series began.
2. Retail inflation was 6.7 per cent in 2022-23 and fell to 1.7 per cent through December 2025.
3. The RBI's inflation target band discussed in the Survey is 3 to 7 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The PIB release on the Survey gives 1.7 per cent for April-December 2025 and traces the fall from 6.7 per cent in 2022-23. The RBI's tolerance band under flexible inflation targeting is 2 to 6 per cent (4 per cent target, plus or minus 2), not 3 to 7.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Inflation chapter; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: Economic Survey 2025-26 attributes India's FY26 growth of 7.4 per cent to a 'double engine' of consumption and investment.
Statement-II: In FY26 (First Advance Estimates), private final consumption expenditure was about 61.5 per cent of GDP and gross fixed capital formation about 30 per cent of GDP.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: PIB's headline on the Survey credits the consumption-investment 'double engine'. The size of both components (PFCE at 61.5 per cent and GFCF at 30 per cent of GDP) is what makes them the twin drivers, so Statement-II explains Statement-I.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, State of the Economy; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: Economic Survey 2025-26 reports that average headline CPI inflation during April-December 2025 was only 1.7 per cent.
Statement-II: Food and fuel together carry a weight of 52.7 per cent in the CPI basket, and vegetable and pulse prices fell during the period.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: With over half the CPI basket in food and fuel, a slump in vegetable and pulse prices pulls the headline number down sharply. That cause-and-effect link is why Statement-II explains Statement-I.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Inflation chapter; PIB, 29 Jan 2026
questions.h: Heavy food weight: veg and pulses fall, headline falls

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the services sector as discussed in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Services GVA grew 9.3 per cent in the first half of FY26, with a full-year estimate of about 9.1 per cent.
2. Services contributed about 53.6 per cent of GDP in H1 FY26.
3. India is the world's third-largest services exporter.
4. Services received an average of 80.2 per cent of total FDI inflows during FY23 to FY25.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1, 2 and 4 match the Survey. India is the world's seventh-largest services exporter, not third, which is the trap in statement 3.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Services chapter; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II as per Economic Survey 2025-26:
List-I
A. Sectors covered by Production Linked Incentive schemes
B. India's rank in the Global Innovation Index 2025
C. Projects approved under the India Semiconductor Mission
D. States across which these semiconductor projects are spread
List-II
1. 6
2. 10
3. 14
4. 38
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The Survey cites PLI schemes in 14 sectors, a GII rank of 38th in 2025 (up from 66th in 2019), and 10 semiconductor projects worth about Rs 1.60 lakh crore across 6 states. Options that swap 14 with 10 or 6 with 10 confuse the project count with the state count.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Industry chapter; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: With reference to infrastructure data cited in Economic Survey 2025-26, which one of the following statements is NOT correct?
o: The national highway network grew from 91,287 km in FY14 to about 1,46,572 km in FY26 (up to December).
The number of airports rose from 74 in 2014 to 164 in 2025.
The power demand-supply gap fell from 4.2 per cent in FY14 to nil in November 2025.
DISCOMs recorded a net loss in FY25 for the first time, as AT&C losses rose to 15.04 per cent.
questions.e: The Survey records the first-ever positive profit after tax for DISCOMs (Rs 2,701 crore in FY25), helped by AT&C losses falling from 22.62 per cent in FY14 to 15.04 per cent. The option reverses both the profit direction and the loss trend.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Investment and Infrastructure; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: Economic Survey 2025-26 estimates foodgrain production for agricultural year 2024-25 at 3,577.3 lakh tonnes, an increase of 254.3 lakh tonnes over the previous year.
Statement-II: Horticulture, which accounts for about one-third of agricultural GVA, produced more in 2024-25 than foodgrains.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both facts come from the Survey's agriculture discussion (horticulture output of roughly 362 to 368 million tonnes against about 357.7 million tonnes of foodgrains). Rising foodgrain output does not cause horticulture to overtake it, so Statement-II is a separate fact, not an explanation.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Agriculture and Food Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about agriculture and allied sectors in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Horticulture accounts for about 33 per cent of agricultural GVA.
2. Livestock GVA rose by nearly 95 per cent between FY15 and FY24.
3. Fish production rose by more than 140 per cent during 2014 to 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Livestock GVA rose by nearly 195 per cent over FY15 to FY24, not 95 per cent; the other two figures are as stated in the Survey. Mind the dropped digit.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Agriculture and Food Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: According to Economic Survey 2025-26, as of 31 December 2025 the e-NAM platform covers 1,522 mandis across how many States and Union Territories?
questions.e: The Survey lists about 1.79 crore farmers, 2.72 crore traders, 4,698 FPOs and 1,522 mandis across 23 States and 4 UTs on e-NAM, the online trading platform for agricultural commodities.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Agriculture and Food Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about poverty and social spending in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. The World Bank revised the international poverty line to USD 3.00 per day (2021 prices).
2. On that line, India's extreme poverty rate in 2022-23 was 23.9 per cent.
3. NITI Aayog's multidimensional poverty headcount fell from 55.3 per cent (2005-06) to 11.28 per cent (2022-23).
4. Social services expenditure was budgeted at about 7.9 per cent of GDP in FY26.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India's extreme poverty rate on the new USD 3.00 line was 5.3 per cent in 2022-23; 23.9 per cent is the rate on the higher lower-middle-income line. The other three statements are as the Survey reports.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Rural Development and Social Progress; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about labour markets in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Female labour force participation rose from 23.3 per cent in 2017-18 to 41.7 per cent in 2023-24.
2. The unemployment rate over the same period fell from 5.6 per cent to 3.2 per cent.
3. The unemployment rate over the same period rose from 3.2 per cent to 5.6 per cent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 reproduce the Survey's PLFS-based trend; statement 3 is just statement 2 reversed, so the two cannot both hold.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Employment and Skill Development; PIB, 29 Jan 2026
questions.h: Female LFPR almost doubled: 23 to 42 in six years

questions.q: According to the UDISE+ 2024-25 data cited in Economic Survey 2025-26, which school stage has the lowest Gross Enrolment Ratio?
questions.e: The Survey gives GER of 90.9 (primary), 90.3 (upper primary), 78.7 (secondary) and 58.4 (higher secondary). The ratio falls at each step up the ladder.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Education and Health; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about health outcomes in Economic Survey 2025-26 (1990 to 2023):
1. India's maternal mortality fell by 86 per cent, against a global fall of 48 per cent.
2. Under-five mortality fell by 78 per cent in India, against 61 per cent globally.
3. Neonatal mortality fell by 54 per cent in India, against 70 per cent globally.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India outperformed the global fall in maternal, under-five and neonatal mortality. For neonatal mortality the numbers are swapped in statement 3: India's fall was 70 per cent and the global fall 54 per cent.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Education and Health; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: Economic Survey 2025-26 notes that central capital expenditure rose from Rs 2.63 lakh crore in FY18 to Rs 11.21 lakh crore in FY26 (BE). This is approximately how many times the FY18 level?
questions.e: 11.21 divided by 2.63 is about 4.26, which the Survey rounds to about 4.2 times.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Investment and Infrastructure; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements based on Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. The national highway network has grown by about 60 per cent since FY14.
2. High-speed corridors grew from 550 km in FY14 to 5,364 km in FY26 (up to December), nearly tenfold.
3. Over 81 per cent of rural households had tap water under the Jal Jeevan Mission by October 2025.
4. India is the third country to achieve autonomous satellite docking through SpaDeX.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Highways grew from 91,287 km to 1,46,572 km (about 60 per cent), and the other two figures in statements 2 and 3 are as stated. SpaDeX made India the fourth nation, after the US, Russia and China, to achieve autonomous docking.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Investment and Infrastructure; PIB, 29 Jan 2026
questions.h: Docking club: US, Russia, China, then India = 4th

questions.q: The SVAMITVA scheme, which figures in the rural development discussion of Economic Survey 2025-26, primarily aims to:
o: provide a pension to small and marginal farmers
provide collateral-free working capital to street vendors
issue property cards to rural households using drone-based mapping of inhabited areas
connect agricultural markets electronically across the country
questions.e: The Survey reports drone surveys completed in about 3.28 lakh villages and about 2.76 crore property cards prepared. The other options describe PM SVANidhi, PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana and e-NAM respectively.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Rural Development and Social Progress; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: In its discussion on urbanisation, Economic Survey 2025-26 cites which project as an example of how regional rail can widen job access and support polycentric growth?
questions.e: The Survey's urbanisation chapter uses the Namo Bharat regional rapid transit system to show how fast regional rail can ease pressure on core metros. The other three are road, sea-link or freight projects, not passenger regional rail.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Urbanisation; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about employment in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. About 56.2 crore persons aged 15 and above were employed in Q2 FY26, roughly 8.7 lakh more than in Q1.
2. Manufacturing employment in the Annual Survey of Industries for FY24 rose by 6 per cent, adding over 10 lakh jobs.
3. Over 54 per cent of the 31 crore workers registered on e-Shram are men.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Survey reports over 54 per cent of e-Shram registrants as women, so statement 3 inverts the gender share. Statements 1 and 2 reproduce its employment data.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Employment and Skill Development; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: Economic Survey 2025-26 mentions that two IIT campuses have been set up abroad. They are located in:
questions.e: The Survey's education chapter notes international IIT campuses at Zanzibar (Tanzania) and Abu Dhabi (UAE), as part of the internationalisation of higher education.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Education and Health; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: In the context of public finance, 'effective capital expenditure' of the Centre, a term used in Economic Survey 2025-26, refers to:
o: capital expenditure plus grants-in-aid given to States for creation of capital assets
capital expenditure net of loans given to States
revenue expenditure net of interest payments
capital expenditure financed only from non-debt receipts
questions.e: Effective capex adds capital grants to States (which create assets on the States' books) to the Centre's own capital expenditure. The Survey puts FY26 BE at Rs 15.48 lakh crore effective capex against Rs 11.21 lakh crore central capex, and averages near 4 per cent of GDP in FY25.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal Developments; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about higher education in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Higher education institutions rose from 51,534 in 2014-15 to 70,018 in June 2025.
2. NEP 2020's target is a 50 per cent Gross Enrolment Ratio in higher education by 2035.
3. The Academic Bank of Credit covers over 4.6 crore IDs across 2,660 institutions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All three are as given in the Survey and in NEP 2020. A Survey of this kind rewards remembering round policy targets (50 per cent GER, 2035) and the order of magnitude of the credit bank.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Education and Health; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about school education data in Economic Survey 2025-26 (UDISE+ 2024-25):
1. The school system has about 24.69 crore students.
2. There are about 14.71 lakh schools.
3. There are over 1.01 crore teachers.
4. Gross Enrolment Ratio at the primary level is 58.4.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The first three figures are from the Survey. A GER of 58.4 belongs to the higher secondary stage; the primary GER is 90.9.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Education and Health; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes as reported in Economic Survey 2025-26 (as of September 2025):
1. Actual investment has crossed Rs 2.0 lakh crore.
2. Incremental production and sales have exceeded Rs 18.7 lakh crore.
3. The schemes have generated over 12.6 crore jobs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Survey reports over 12.6 lakh jobs, not crore; claiming crore inflates the employment figure a hundredfold. The investment and production numbers are right.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Industry chapter; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements based on Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. India's railway network was 69,439 route km in March 2025.
2. India is the world's second-largest domestic aviation market.
3. About 91.1 per cent of the railway network was electrified by October 2025.
4. 5G services are available in 99.9 per cent of districts.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 4 are in the Survey. India is the third-largest domestic aviation market, and railway electrification stood at 99.1 per cent, not 91.1 per cent.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Investment and Infrastructure; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about horticulture and food production in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. India is the second-largest producer of vegetables.
2. India is the second-largest producer of fruits.
3. India is the largest producer of potatoes in the world.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Survey ranks India second in vegetables, fruits and potatoes, each at roughly 12 to 13 per cent of global output. China leads in potatoes, so statement 3 fails.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Agriculture and Food Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: What is the cumulative reduction in the policy repo rate since February 2025 reported in Economic Survey 2025-26?
questions.e: The Survey records a cumulative cut of 125 basis points since February 2025 (the easing cycle took the rate from 6.50 to 5.25 per cent), alongside liquidity injections through CRR cuts and open market operations.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: Economic Survey 2025-26 notes that the gross NPA ratio of scheduled commercial banks fell to a multi-decadal low of 2.2 per cent in September 2025.
Statement-II: The net NPA ratio of scheduled commercial banks was a record low of about 0.5 per cent in September 2025.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both asset-quality indicators are reported in the Survey. They describe the same trend, but a low net NPA ratio is a separate measure (after provisions) and does not explain the low gross NPA ratio.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management and Financial Intermediation; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about financial and sovereign indicators in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Scheduled commercial bank credit grew 14.5 per cent year-on-year as of December 2025, up from 11.2 per cent a year earlier.
2. S&P upgraded India's sovereign rating from BBB to BBB+.
3. India received three sovereign rating upgrades in 2025, including from Morningstar DBRS and R&I.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: S&P moved India from BBB- to BBB, not BBB to BBB+. The three 2025 upgrades were by Morningstar DBRS, S&P Global and R&I.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal and Monetary chapters; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II using data from Economic Survey 2025-26:
List-I
A. India's share of global merchandise exports, 2005
B. India's share of global merchandise exports, 2024
C. India's share of global commercial services exports, 2005
D. India's share of global commercial services exports, 2024
List-II (per cent)
1. 2.0
2. 1.0
3. 4.3
4. 1.8
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Merchandise exports share rose from 1.0 to 1.8 per cent between 2005 and 2024, and services exports from 2.0 to 4.3 per cent. Services roughly doubled its share while merchandise nearly did.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, External Sector; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's external sector in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Total exports (goods and services) reached a record USD 825.3 billion in FY25, up 6.1 per cent.
2. Services exports of USD 387.6 billion in FY25 grew by 6.1 per cent.
3. Non-petroleum exports hit a record USD 374.3 billion in FY25.
4. India received the second-largest remittance inflow in the world in FY25.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Services exports grew 13.6 per cent, and at USD 135.4 billion India was the largest recipient of remittances in the world.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, External Sector; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's foreign exchange reserves in Economic Survey 2025-26 (as of 16 January 2026):
1. Reserves stood at about USD 701.4 billion.
2. They covered about 11 months of imports.
3. They covered about 94 per cent of external debt.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All three are in the Survey: USD 701.4 billion, roughly 11 months of imports and about 94 per cent of external debt. The external debt cover figure refers to end-September 2025 debt.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, External Sector; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about foreign investment in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Gross FDI inflows were USD 64.7 billion during April to November 2025.
2. India ranked fourth globally in greenfield investment announcements in 2024.
3. India was the largest destination for greenfield digital investments during 2020 to 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All three appear in the Survey's external sector chapter. The ranking in statement 2 is based on announcements (over 1,000 projects), not actual inflows.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, External Sector; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India's fiscal position in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. The fiscal deficit was budgeted at 4.4 per cent of GDP for FY26, down from 4.8 per cent in FY25.
2. The medium-term debt target is 50 plus or minus 1 per cent of GDP by FY31.
3. The Centre's fiscal deficit target for FY26 was 4.8 per cent of GDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: FY26's budgeted fiscal deficit was 4.4 per cent; 4.8 per cent was the FY25 level. The 50 plus or minus 1 per cent debt anchor by FY31 is the medium-term target in both the Survey and the Budget.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal Developments; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about central and state finances in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Central effective capital expenditure averaged about 2.7 per cent of GDP before the pandemic and about 4 per cent in FY25.
2. The combined fiscal deficit of States rose to about 3.2 per cent of GDP in FY25.
3. The Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI) provides interest-free long-term loans to States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All three statements reflect the Survey's fiscal chapter. SASCI loans, being interest-free, helped States hold capital spending near 2.4 per cent of GDP in FY25 despite a wider deficit.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal Developments; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following data points from Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Gross GST collections during April to December 2025 were Rs 17.4 lakh crore, up 6.7 per cent year-on-year.
2. E-way bill volumes during April to December 2025 rose 21 per cent year-on-year.
3. Income tax returns filed rose from 6.9 crore in FY22 to 9.2 crore in FY25.
4. GST taxpayers fell from 1.5 crore to 60 lakh between 2017 and 2025.
How many of the above are correct?
questions.e: GST taxpayers rose from 60 lakh in 2017 to over 1.5 crore; the statement reverses this. The other three data points are as reported.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal Developments; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Economic Survey 2025-26 outlines a progression for its import-substitution framework. Arrange the following stages in the correct order:
1. Strategic Indispensability
2. Swadeshi
3. Strategic Resilience
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The Survey moves from disciplined Swadeshi (self-reliance where it matters), to strategic resilience (buffers against shocks), to strategic indispensability (being hard for others to do without). It pairs this with a National Input Cost Reduction Strategy.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Import Substitution and Strategic Resilience; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Statement-I: Economic Survey 2025-26 records that non-fossil sources made up about 51.93 per cent of India's installed power capacity at the end of December 2025.
Statement-II: India's updated NDC (2022) commits to achieving about 50 per cent cumulative electric power installed capacity from non-fossil sources by 2030.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: India crossed the 50 per cent mark ahead of the 2030 target, as the Survey notes. The NDC pledge sets the benchmark against which the figure is judged, but it does not explain why capacity reached that share.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Environment and Climate Change; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: Which one of the following best reflects the view on artificial intelligence in the AI ecosystem chapter of Economic Survey 2025-26?
o: Smaller, task-specific models that can run on local hardware can spread AI benefits more evenly and lower entry barriers.
India should focus solely on building the largest general-purpose models to compete with global leaders.
AI adoption should be restricted to the services sector to protect manufacturing employment.
AI demand in India is driven mainly by consumer entertainment applications.
questions.e: The Survey stresses smaller task-specific models and AI that works on local hardware in low-resource settings, with demand coming from healthcare, agriculture, urban management, education and public administration. The other options contradict this.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, AI Ecosystem; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: The Labour Codes, which Economic Survey 2025-26 notes as formally recognising gig and platform workers, consolidate how many central labour laws into four codes?
questions.e: The four Labour Codes (wages, industrial relations, social security, occupational safety) subsume 29 central laws and were notified on 21 November 2025. The Social Security Code is the one that recognises gig and platform workers.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Employment and Skill Development; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about gig and platform workers in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Their number rose from 77 lakh in FY21 to 120 lakh in FY25.
2. They now form over 2 per cent of India's workforce.
3. Non-agricultural gig work is projected to reach 6.7 per cent of the workforce by 2029-30.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All three are as reported in the Survey, which treats gig work as a growing source of flexible employment now backed by the Labour Codes.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Employment and Skill Development; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Scheme)
A. Stand-Up India
B. PM SVANidhi
C. e-NAM
D. PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
List-II (Feature)
1. Collateral-free working capital for street vendors
2. Loans of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises of SC, ST and women entrepreneurs
3. Online trading platform for agricultural commodities
4. Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: These schemes are all cited in the Survey's financial inclusion and agriculture discussion. Stand-Up India targets greenfield enterprises, SVANidhi targets street vendors, e-NAM is a market platform, and PM-KMY is a pension scheme.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management; Agriculture chapters; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about capital markets in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. The number of unique investors in the capital market crossed 12 crore in September 2025.
2. The 2025 Financial Sector Assessment Programme (FSAP) is a joint exercise of the IMF and the World Bank.
3. Capital markets fell from 175 per cent of GDP in CY2017 to 144 per cent in CY2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The FSAP found capital markets rose from 144 per cent of GDP (CY2017) to 175 per cent (CY2024); statement 3 reverses this. Statements 1 and 2 are correct.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
With reference to the Economic Survey, consider the following statements:
1. The first Economic Survey was presented for the year 1950-51.
2. It was delinked from the Union Budget and presented separately from 1964.
3. Economic Survey 2025-26 was tabled in Parliament on 29 January 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Survey began in 1950-51 as part of the Budget papers, was separated in 1964, and the 2025-26 edition was tabled on 29 January 2026 ahead of the Budget on 1 February 2026.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26; PIB, 29 Jan 2026; Ramesh Singh

questions.q: Which of the following is proposed in Economic Survey 2025-26 as a means to treat competitiveness as infrastructure?
o: A uniform customs duty on all imports
A National Input Cost Reduction Strategy
A ban on foreign portfolio investment
questions.e: The Survey's import-substitution chapter proposes a National Input Cost Reduction Strategy, treating affordable and reliable inputs as infrastructure for domestic manufacturers.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Import Substitution and Strategic Resilience; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Centre's revenue in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Revenue receipts rose from about 8.5 per cent of GDP (FY16 to FY20 average) to about 9.2 per cent in FY25 (provisional actuals).
2. Non-corporate tax collections rose from about 2.4 per cent of GDP before the pandemic to about 3.3 per cent after.
3. Corporate tax rose from about 2.4 per cent of GDP to about 3.3 per cent of GDP.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 2.4 to 3.3 per cent rise is for non-corporate tax, not corporate tax, so statement 3 mislabels it. Statements 1 and 2 are as reported.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Fiscal Developments; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: Economic Survey 2025-26 describes the Viksit Bharat-G RAM G as:
o: a credit guarantee scheme for MSMEs
a new scheme for housing in urban areas
a statutory overhaul of MGNREGS aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047
a mission for digital literacy in schools
questions.e: The Survey's rural development chapter refers to VB-G RAM G as a statutory overhaul of the MGNREGS rural employment guarantee, aligned with the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Rural Development and Social Progress; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about inclusion and credit schemes in Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana had about 55.02 crore accounts in March 2025, of which about 36.63 crore were in rural and semi-urban areas.
2. Under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana, about Rs 36.18 lakh crore had been disbursed across 55.45 crore loan accounts by October 2025.
3. More than 21.6 crore demat accounts existed, with about 235 lakh added in FY26 up to December 2025.
4. Mutual fund unique investors stood at about 5.9 crore at the end of December 2025.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: All four figures are reported in the Survey's financial inclusion and capital market discussion, so the answer is all four. In such questions, check for digit swaps before assuming one is a trap.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management and Financial Intermediation; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q: In the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), the unemployment rate in the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach, as used in Economic Survey 2025-26, is based on:
o: activity in the seven days preceding the survey
the principal activity of the previous year only
questions.e: CWS uses a reference period of the previous seven days, while Usual Status uses the previous 365 days. The Survey notes that CWS unemployment declined in the first half of FY26.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Employment; MoSPI PLFS; PIB, 29 Jan 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about GIFT City, referred to in Economic Survey 2025-26 as India's first International Financial Services Centre:
1. It is located in Gujarat.
2. Financial services in IFSCs are regulated by a unified authority, the International Financial Services Centres Authority.
3. It is regulated exclusively by the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: GIFT City (Gandhinagar, Gujarat) is India's first IFSC, and the IFSCA is the unified regulator for banking, capital markets and insurance there. SEBI alone does not regulate it, so statement 3 fails.
questions.s: Economic Survey 2025-26, Monetary Management; IFSCA Act 2019
